description:

title: Senior Business Development Associate
description:

They join, support, and collaborate with teams focused on specific opportunities, ensuring that the pursuit of new business is rigorous, disciplined, and ethical. They collaborate closely to craft strategies and plans and set the standard for creative excellence in business development.

Why is this role important for IDEO's work?

Business Development is at the heart of connecting IDEO's creative capabilities with the people and organisations who need them. It's about more than winning new work. It's about understanding our clients' challenges, building trusted relationships, and helping shape opportunities where human-centred design can make a meaningful difference.

title: Mission Critical Security Engineer – Threat Hunting
description:
Help protect what truly matters in our customers' most critical environments by proactively identifying threats and improving how they are detected and addressed.

As a Mission Critical Security Engineer with a focus on Threat Hunting, you will be part of a dedicated customer team responsible for securing and continuously improving a complex, mission-critical application landscape.

Working alongside other engineers and security specialists, you will help ensure the environment remains as secure and resilient as possible. You combine a strong engineering foundation with a security mindset, taking ownership of security improvements and understanding how systems, applications, and infrastructure behave.

Your specific focus will be on threat hunting and detection engineering. Using your in-depth knowledge of the customer's technology stack and application landscape, you will fine-tune existing detection use cases and develop new ones tailored to the environment. You will use our custom SIEM/SOAR-based Managed Detection and Response (MDR) platform to turn emerging threats and technical insights into actionable detection capabilities.

This role bridges security engineering, detection engineering, and threat intelligence. You don't simply follow predefined playbooks. You understand system behavior, identify gaps, and develop practical solutions that strengthen the security of the customer's environment.

/ What you will do

Threat intelligence & continuous improvement

  • Actively follow security developments, vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence and translate these into relevant hunts and detections.

  • Identify security risks and gaps in detection coverage and proactively propose improvements.

  • Use your knowledge of the customer's application and infrastructure landscape to continuously strengthen its security posture.

title: Junior Product Manager – IT Fulfillment
description:
Every order a Suitsupply customer places, online, in a store, or through customer service, has to be captured, understood and carried all the way through to delivery or return. As Junior Product Manager for IT Fulfillment, you will help build and improve the services that make that happen: the order flows, data and interfaces that connect our webstore, our stores, our warehouses and our customer service teams.
You will work in a small team inside the IT Fulfillment domain, alongside the Group Product Manager and our own engineers. The Group Product Manager shapes the functional direction with the business and sets priorities; together you turn it into clear requirements, well-defined tickets and working software, built with engineers and AI agents. This is a technical product role: we build our own services, so you will spend your time in data models, interfaces and requirements rather than managing a vendor’s roadmap. You start close to delivery, with support while you learn the domain, and grow into owning more of the roadmap.
What you will do
  • Turn mapped-out functional flows into clear, buildable work: technical requirements, acceptance criteria and user stories that engineers and AI agents can pick up without coming back with questions.
  • Own the detail as both product manager and business analyst: the data model, the way systems talk to each other, and the edge cases nobody thought of yet.
  • Break large changes into chunks that can be built, tested and released safely, and keep the backlog in a state where work can start at any moment.
  • Work with engineers day to day in refinement, planning, reviews and releases, and use our AI tooling to draft, structure and pressure-test the work before it reaches them.
  • Design our order data and interfaces so that AI agents can read, reason over and act on them as reliably as our own systems do.
